title: Hydrogen-like species
statement:
Which ion fits a one-electron Bohr model with Z=3?

[_]{a}

explanations: Lithium has three protons and this ion has one electron.
It has one electron but Z=2.
It has two electrons and Z=1.

hints: One electron remains after losing two.
solution: Start from nuclear charge 3. Count electrons after ionization. One electron remains after losing two. Lithium has three protons and this ion has one electron.
